strings.privacy.title: Zinsinsi
strings.privacy.description: Momwe pdff imagwiritsira ntchito mafayilo anu: palibe akaunti, palibe chikalata chosungidwa, palibe zotsatsa ndi palibe kugulitsanso deta.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff imamveka m'njira yoti zikalata zanu zikhale zanu. Nayi m'mawu osavuta, zomwe zimachita mukayigwiritsa ntchito.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mafayilo anu
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Amatumizidwa mwachinsinsi (HTTPS), amakonzedwa mokha, ndiyeno n'kuchotsedwa zotsatira zikangokhalapo. Mafayilo akuluakulu amadutsa kusungirako kwakanthawi pansi pa dzina losasintha ndipo amachotsedwa ntchito ikangotha; kuyeretsa kodzipereka kumachotsa chilichonse chomwe chingatsale pasanatha maola 24.

strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff sipempha kulembetsa, adiresi ya imelo kapena kirediti kadi. Zikalata zanu sizimawerengedwa, kuwunikidwa, kugawidwa kapena kugwiritsidwa ntchito kuphunzitsa luntha lochita kupanga.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kuyeza omvera
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Timawerenga maulendo popanda kudziwika ndi popanda ma cookies (Vercel Web Analytics) kuti tiphunzire zida zomwe zili zothandiza. Palibe zotsatsa, palibe kutsatira kachitidwe ka webusaiti.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ma cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie imodzi, yosankha: imakumbukira chiyankhulo chomwe mwasankha.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kusungira patsamba
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Tsambali limasungidwa ndi Vercel pa maseva ku Paris; kusintha kwa Word, Excel ndi PowerPoint kumayang'aniridwa ndi Render ku Frankfurt. Othandizawa amangogwira ntchito ndi mafayilo nthawi ya kusintha kokha.

strings.legal.security.description: Zomwe zimachitika ku mafayilo anu pa pdff: kukonzekera kodzipangira, popanda kusanthula, kuchotsedwa mwamsanga, kubisa, kukhala ku Europe, ndi njira yoyika pa seva yanu.

strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Mafayilo anu amakonzedwaokha, ndikuchotsedwa mwamsanga zotsatira zikakhala zokonzeka kapena kutsitsidwa. strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Palibe kusanthula
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Palibe amene amawerenga zikalata zanu. Sizinalembedwe m'ndandanda, kusanthulidwa, kugawana kapena kugwiritsidwa ntchito kuphunzitsa luntha lochita kupanga (AI). pdff ilibe maakaunti, palibe zotsatsa komanso palibe mbiri ya ogwiritsa ntchito.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Kubisa
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Kulumikizana kulikonse kumabisika (HTTPS) ndipo tsambali limakakamiza chitetezo paulendo uliwonse (HSTS). Chida choteteza chimabisa ma PDF anu ndi AES-256; mawu achinsinsi omwe mwasankha samasungidwa konse.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Kumene mafayilo anu amakonzedwera
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Zida za tsamba, PDF ndi zithunzi: Vercel, malo a data ku Paris (France, European Union). Kusintha kwa Word, Excel ndi PowerPoint: Render, ku Frankfurt (Germany, European Union). Mafayilo oposa 4 MB: malo osungira a Vercel Blob osakhalitsa, pansi pa dzina losasinthika, ochotsedwa pambuyo pogwiritsidwa ntchito.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Zitetezo zaukadaulo
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Mutu wachitetezo (HSTS, kuletsa tsambali kuti lisayikidwe m'masamba ena, chitetezo ku chisokonezo cha mtundu wa fayilo), adilesi ya fayilo yosakhalitsa yomwe singaganizidwe, komanso ntchito yosinthira yomwe imangovomereza zopempha zomwe zili ndi chizindikiro chobisika. Kusintha kulikonse kwa khodi kumasanthulidwa (mayeso, kuwona mitundu) musanapite pa intaneti.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Zachinsinsi ndi lamulo loyenera
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff imasindikizidwa ku New Brunswick ndipo imatsata Lamulo la Kuteteza Zidziwitso za Munthu Payekha ndi Zikalata za Eletironiki la Canada (PIPEDA). Sitisonkhanitsa zidziwitso zilizonse zaumwini za ogwiritsa ntchito: palibe akaunti, palibe imelo, palibe cookie yotsata. Imangidwa pazikhulupiriro zofanana ndi za European GDPR ndi Lamulo 25 la Quebec: kuchepetsa data, osabwereza, kuchotsa pambuyo pokonzekera.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kukonzekera mabungwe okhala ndi malamulo okhwima
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Ngati malamulo anu amaletsa kutumiza zikalata ku ntchito yakunja, ikani pdff pa seva yanu. strings.legal.accessibility.description: Ndemanga ya kupezeka kwa pdff: cholinga cha WCAG 2.2 mulingo wa AA, njira zoyika, malire odziwika ndi momwe mungalongosolere vuto.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Aliyense ayenera kuthatha kugwiritsa ntchito pdff, kuphatikiza anthu osawona kapena osawona bwino, osamva, kapena omwe ali ndi vuto la thupi kapena malingaliro.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Mulingo wolunjika
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff cholinga chake n'kugwirizana ndi Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, mulingo AA, mulingo wapadziko lonse wa W3C. Mlingowu ukuphimba zofunikira za Mulingo wa Boma la Canada pa Kupezeka kwa Webusayiti, mulingo waku Europe EN 301 549 ndi Gawo 508 ku United States, omwe amatchula WCAG 2.0 kapena 2.1 mulingo AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Momwe ziliri
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff imagwirizana mwa gawo ndi WCAG 2.2 mulingo AA: malire odziwika alembedwa pansipa. Ndemangayi yachitika potengera kuwunika kwamkati komwe kunachitika pa Okutobala 2, 2026, pogwiritsa ntchito zida zodzipangira zokha (axe, Lighthouse) komanso kuwona pamanja (kibodi, kusiyana, kusinthira kukula, zilengezo). Palibe kafukufuku wodziyimira pawokha amene wachitika akadali pano.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Zomwe zilipo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Tsamba lonseli limagwira ntchito ndi kibodi, ndi ulalo wa “Lumikira ku zinthu zazikulu” ndi mzere wowoneka bwino pa chinthu chomwe chikugwira ntchito. Kusiyana kwa malemba kuli osachepera 4.5:1. Masitepe a ntchito (kweza, zotsatira, zolakwika) amalengezedwa kwa owerenga pazenera. Dongosolo la fayilo likhoza kusinthidwa popanda kukoka ndi kugwetsa, pogwiritsa ntchito mabatani. Tsambali limatsata zoikamo za chipangizo chanu za “kuchepetsa kayendedwe”: zithunzi zimasiya kusewera kwathunthu. Masamba amakhalabe owerengeka pa chikulitsiro cha 400% komanso pa foni. Chilankhulo cha tsamba lililonse chimatchulidwa, ndipo Chiarabu chimasonyezwa kuchokera kumanja kupita kumanzere.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Malire odziwika
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Popanda zoikamo zimenezo, zithunzi zokongola (zakumbuyo, mphete, chizindikiro cha mtundu) zimayenda nthawi zonse; chizindikiro chimayimitsa pakuyika mbewa ndi pa kibodi. Mphete yojambulidwa patsamba lalikulu imagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi mbewa kapena chala; ndi yokongola, ndipo mndandanda wamitundu yomwe imasonyeza ukapezekanso ngati malemba patsamba. Zilankhulo zotembenuzidwa ndi makina zikhoza kukhala zolakwika. Pomaliza, kupezeka kwa chikalata chopangidwa kumadalira choyambirira: pdff sawonjezera zilembo zopezera ku PDF yomwe ilibe.

strings.tools.fusionner.guide.uses[2]: Sinthani zithunzi za foni za zikalata kukhala PDF imodzi yoyera.

strings.tools.fusionner.guide.steps[1].text: Kokani, kapena gwwiritsani ntchito mivi ndi kusankha kwa A→Z.
